values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A ONEOK press release from August 2025 says the Eiger Express Pipeline will help meet international demand for LNG exports and holds reserved capacity for deliveries to the Corpus Christi, Texas, market. EIA's October 2026 pipeline projects list also gives LNG as the demand served.

verifications.note: ONEOK release names Eiger Express and lists international demand for LNG exports among the drivers, and reserved capacity for the Corpus Christi market

records.researcher_notes: LNG exports are one of several demand drivers named for this line, and no single terminal is named, so the terminal is left blank.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: The line runs from the Elba Island LNG terminal in Georgia. A 2016 FERC order approved the Elba Express Modification Project so the pipeline could carry domestic gas on a firm basis to the new Elba Liquefaction Project for export.

verifications.note: FERC order of June 1, 2016 says Elba Express proposed the modification to transport domestically produced gas on a firm basis to the Elba Liquefaction Project

records.researcher_notes: The source ties the Elba Express system to feedgas for Elba Island liquefaction and export. The modification may not have its own row, so the tag sits on the main line. Please check.

ledger.note: ONEOK release names LNG exports among demand drivers; terminal not named.
FERC 2016 order ties Elba Express modification to feedgas for Elba Island liquefaction.
